name: ephpm/worker
description: Base SDK for ePHPm persistent worker mode — primitives and IDE stubs.

ephpm.comment: stubs/ephpm-worker.stub.php is an IDE/static-analysis stub ONLY. It is intentionally NOT listed in autoload.files: at runtime the Ephpm\Worker\take_request() / send_response() functions and the Envelope class are provided natively by the ephpm engine, and autoloading the stub would redefine them and fatal. Point your analyzer (PhpStorm, Psalm, PHPStan) at the stubs/ directory instead.
